title: operator-ephemeral-lease-enforcer-kms-origin-proof-and-ordered-audit-forwarder
author: Nina Alvarez
description: Summary: Add an operator-scoped ephemeral lease enforcer that binds short-lived operator credentials to a KMS origin assertion and a geozone/region pin. Complement this with an ordered-audit-forwarder service that assigns monotonic sequence anchors to audit envelopes before persisting/forwarding, preventing replay and out-of-order ingestion across regions. Motivation: production incidents showed operators reusing long-lived credentials across zones and audit ingestion gaps during burst failover; both increase blast radius and make investigations unreliable. This PR implements three coordinated pieces: 1) RBAC v2 mappings and controller support to mint ephemeral operator leases constrained by operator scope, allowed regions, and KMS origin claim; 2) KMS origin-proof validator in the request path that rejects requests where ciphertext provenance doesn't match the lease's pinned region/provider; 3) Ordered Audit Forwarder: a lightweight sequencer that stamps audit envelopes with a monotonic anchor and verifies ordering on replay to downstream sinks. Design notes: - Leases are represented as signed JWTs (lease_jwt) containing operator_id, scope, allowed_regions, kms_origin_fingerprint, issued_at, expires_at, and nonce. Leases are minted by the OperatorLeaseController after RBAC v2 decision. - Request interceptor validates lease_jwt, performs KMS origin proof lookups (cached for 1m), and enforces region pin and provider match. Mismatch -> 403 and audit entry with rejection reason. - Ordered Audit Forwarder runs as a sidecar/standalone deployment in Private and Dedicated. It maintains a small in-memory per-stream counter persisted to RocksDB for ordering recovery. Forwarder includes a fast local health probe to avoid acknowledging inbound producers until ordering state is recovered. Migration & rollout: - Default rollout is opt-in via feature-flag operator.leases.v1; CLI and Terraform modules updated to enable in private installs. - We ship a canary forwarder image to a single region and enable the request validation as a canary mode (fail-open) for 72h before enforcing. Checklist: - [x] RBAC v2 policy changes and unit tests - [x] OperatorLeaseController implementation + e2e harness - [x] Request interceptor and KMS origin proof cache - [x] Ordered Audit Forwarder binary + resilience tests - [x] Documentation and migration guide - [x] Terraform module updates for private installer - [x] Benchmarks for sequencer throughput (see /bench/seq-run.md) Commits (high-level): - init: scaffold operator lease controller, API types and migrations - impl: lease minting, validation, tests - add: KMS origin proofer and cache + mock provider for tests - add: ordered-audit-forwarder service and persistence shim - docs: rollout/migration guide, CLI flag docs - ci: add integration matrix and stress nightly job Files changed (high-level): - services/operator-lease/{controller.go, types.go, api.md, controller_test.go} - services/request-interceptor/validate_lease.go - services/request-interceptor/kms_proof_cache.go - services/ordered-audit-forwarder/main.go - services/ordered-audit-forwarder/seq_store.go - infra/terraform/modules/private-installer/lease_feature_flag.tf - docs/operator-leases.md - e2e/harness/operator_lease_flow.yaml CI run summary: - Initial CI run: unit tests pass, integration flaky on audit-forwarder (sequence race in test harness) -> fail on integration. - After test harness fix (seq_store locking), re-run CI: all checks green (unit, integration, lint, gofmt). - Nightly stress ran successfully at 20k events/min with 5% synthetic drop simulation. Security review: - Threat model updated to include replay/resend and lease theft scenarios. Mitigations: short TTLs (default 5m), nonce baked into lease_jwt, and forwarder signs anchored envelopes with server key (rotated daily). Backwards compatibility: default is opt-in; when feature-flag is enabled in enforcement mode, requests without a valid lease are rejected. Migration guide included for partners to bulk-mint operator leases for existing operator principals. Release notes excerpt: "Add operator-scoped ephemeral leases (opt-in) to bind operator credentials to KMS origin and region; introduce ordered audit forwarder to protect audit ingestion from replays and out-of-order writes. Opt-in rollout and migration steps included." Merge outcome: merged after approval from SRE and Security, squash-merged to main.

review_comments: Thomas Reed: Can we guarantee the seq_store recovery path won't block the forwarder for more than 5s on restart? Consider checkpointing a compacted snapshot to speed recovery.
Maya Chen: The KMS origin verifier depends on provider metadata. Add a fallback stale cache mode for short network partitions; otherwise we risk mass 403s during provider outages.
Elliot Brooks: RBAC rule changes look good but please add an explicit deny for cross-region operator token exchange in the policy matrix. Also add unit tests for deny cases.
author_responses: Nina Alvarez: Added snapshotting to seq_store; recovery now reads snapshot+delta which reduced cold restart time from ~12s to ~700ms. See seq_store.go changes.
Nina Alvarez: Implemented a 'stale-allow' cache mode behind the feature flag; docs updated to describe tradeoffs. During enforcement run we keep this off.
Nina Alvarez: Added explicit deny rules to rbac v2 matrix and unit tests covering cross-region exchange attempts.
post_merge_actions: Notify private-install ops channel with migration playbook and Terraform toggle instructions
Schedule canary rollout for forwarder in us-west-2 (Nov 15) and enforcement (Nov 19)
Backport hotfix for seq_store race to release/2025-11 branch if issues observed
release_notes: Opt-in feature: operator-scoped ephemeral leases (short TTL) bound to KMS origin and region; ordered audit forwarder to ensure monotonic audit ingestion. Feature is disabled by default; see docs/operator-leases.md for migration and enabling steps.
notes_for_ops: When enabling enforcement, ensure the KMS origin cache endpoint is reachable. If a provider outage occurs, toggle operator.leases.enforce=false to fail-open for a short window while remediation occurs.
regression_tests: e2e/harness/operator_lease_flow.yaml and services/ordered-audit-forwarder/seq_store_test.go include synthetic partition and restart scenarios; ran nightly stress to validate throughput and ordering under 5% packet loss.
notes: This PR touches production request path for Private and Dedicated installs. Keep security on page during rollout.
